extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism claims from XML/PDF result sections, methods, and figure captions; automated pending mechanism notes were replaced with bounded claims.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: temporin-1CEa in MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7 breast cancer cells
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary results support rapid cancer-cell membrane disruption/permeability changes after temporin-1CEa exposure.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is bounded to cell-membrane integrity/permeability evidence; pore structure or stoichiometry is not established.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary results support intracellular calcium elevation under calcium-containing and calcium-free conditions as a mechanism context for rapid cytotoxicity.
direct_assay_types: Fluo3-AM calcium flow cytometry in calcium-containing solution
Fluo3-AM calcium flow cytometry in calcium-free solution

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=10:Temporin-1CEa Increases Cytosolic Calcium Level; xml:fig=7

mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper reports involvement of calcium-related mechanisms but states that detailed intracellular signaling awaits further investigation.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary results support ROS elevation and mitochondrial membrane-potential loss as downstream cell-death context after temporin-1CEa treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: ROS and mitochondrial potential are retained as downstream context, not as an independently complete molecular target mechanism.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Figures 3-9 are source-located and used qualitatively; exact bar heights not stated in text were not fabricated.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The paper-local supplementary directory is empty and the landed supplementary .bin files are HTML pages or article/guideline pages, not PDF/XLSX/DOCX/CSV supplementary data payloads.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No supplement-only activity, toxicity, database, or mechanism values were fabricated. Primary XML/PDF text and database JSONL rows were sufficient to repair the worker-2/4/6 blockers.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local XML/PDF text gives exact example values at 40 µM and qualitative dose-response/caption summaries, but it does not tabulate all bar heights from Figures 1 and 3-9.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Only exact values stated in text were extracted as activity rows. Other figure-only quantitative values remain qualitative mechanism context and were not digitized or invented.
